title: Operator
description:
The Operator is responsible for delivering safe, efficient, and reliable PSD to customers. The Operator identifies opportunities to improve service delivery, and assists field and maintenance crews with preparing equipment for operations.

  • Must be fully operational:
    • Operate and maintain:
      • Separator, choke manifold, tanks, flow lines
    • Monitor and control:
      • Pressure, temperature, and flow rates
      • Tank levels and production volumes
    • Perform:
      • Tank gauging
      • Basic production / flow calculations
    • Support rig-up/rig-down and equipment maintenance
    • Prior field execution experience on active well testing jobs
    • Vocational or craft diploma / certificate
    • CARICOM national with technical qualifications and 5 years minimum experience in operations: offshore rigs, deepwater preferred
    • Holder of valid CSME or meet eligibility to obtain same in reasonable timeframe
    • Must be able to work independently
    • Must be able to work under pressure in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
    • Must be able to work with the team in developing improved work processes for the department
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • Intermediate Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
    • Good problem-solving abilities, proactive, fast learner, good organizational and time management skills, positive attitude
    SLB offers equal employment opportunity. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.
